result.legend: Unified diff, source-as-written → enriched: `-` lines are the original, `+` lines add the compiler's inline `// ⟹` insertions and explode wildcard/`given` imports (with symbols=on). Render in any diff viewer for green/red. Notes show compiler insertions invisible in the source: `(using …)` implicit args, `name(…)` implicit conversion, `[…]` inferred type args, `: T` inferred type. symbols=on adds a type→package legend.
